improvement: Added og:title/og:description/og:type (meta description already present, left untouched per skip-if-present rule)
Ported formatWorldName's timestamp/suffix-stripping regex from index.html into v3.html's standalone formatWorldName(path) function
Added a standalone makePortalLabel(text) function (v3.html uses plain functions, not a class, so this is index.html's method body adapted to a free function rather than `this.makePortalLabel`)
Added `if (world && world.name) portalGroup.add(makePortalLabel(world.name));` right after `const portalGroup = new THREE.Group();` in createPortalWithIframe()
v3.html has no fogColor/portalColor1/cameraHeight URL-parameter travel state to begin with — nothing to preserve or break there
payload.notes: Confirmed pre-existing by re-testing git show HEAD:v3.html through the identical harness before any of my edits: same error classes and counts. My additions (og tags, formatWorldName port, makePortalLabel) did not add any new error type or increase severity. Left the underlying CapsuleGeometry/null-trim defects alone — out of surgical scope.
